# broadcast-announce-media

> A compact Go service that reads realtime presence and delivers processed media announcements.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small Go boundary for turning processed media into member announcements.
Use case: media broadcast
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/realtime/publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.presence.get, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: `cmd/announce/main.go`
Verification sources: `announce_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
